articles.description: Nvidia jumped more than 30% and has recovered most of its losses since CEO Jensen Huang stepped down, but bitcoin is lagging as U.S. selling persists, traders said.

articles.description: Bitcoin price upside hit $64,500 as risk assets surged on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s reinstatement, while crypto liquidations topped $500 million four hours.

articles.title: Cross River Bank enters Bitcoin-backed lending with $250K loans
articles.description: The US bank is offering Bitcoin-backed loans ranging from $10,000 to $250,000 through LendingUSA, allowing borrowers to access cash without selling their holdings.

articles.title: Binance hackers push $247 million through transactions designed to cloud the source
articles.description: Elliptic found that nearly all the mixing transactions, known as coinjoins, were coordinated by an entity called Kruw during fixed daily hours, suggesting potential handoffs to China-based money launderers.

articles.description: The Nasdaq-listed crypto miner can borrow without selling its reserves or issuing new shares, but falling BTC prices could force it to pledge more collateral.
